description:
Items and skins you can view on the 3D player model (Skin Lab). Every item Skin Lab has a 3D model for (clothing, armour, guns and tools, deployables, building skins,
vehicles), in viewer order. Each row has `shortname`, `name`, `slot` / `slot_name` (where the viewer puts it),
`group`, `worn` (false = stood beside the player rather than worn), `female_model`, `takes_attachments`,
`skins_in_3d` (accepted Workshop and built-in skins with 3D textures), `cheapest_skin` / `priciest_skin` (Steam
lowest listing, USD cents), `viewer_url` (the item in its default look) and the wiki `page`. More skins are added
as they're processed. Skin Lab is rust.wiki's 3D try-on viewer for Rust skins. Use this to see which items and slots it covers; give the user the viewer_url so they can open it.

search.description: Case-insensitive match on the item's name or shortname.

slot.description: Viewer slot: head, face, shirt, jacket, chest-armour, gloves, pants, leg-armour, shoes, back, weapon, deployable, building, vehicle (or its number).

with_skins.description: Also list each item's N most expensive 3D skins (0 = counts only).
